title: Query-log tests are split by lifecycle stage
goal: The classes of _tools/test_querylog.py live in test_ql_capture.py, test_ql_distill.py, test_ql_store.py, test_ql_learn.py, test_ql_deliver.py, test_ql_research.py and test_ql_report.py with their shared helpers in one helper module, test class and function names are unchanged, test_querylog.py is gone, every open item's touches and checks name the new files, and the suite passes

run: TestLearn or selfdoc or plugin or red_pipeline or change_router or files_a_bug

notes: Stages by class: capture (HookRows, Switches, ToolRows, NoHooks, HookConfig), distill (Distill, SpoolFormats, Lock, Launch), store (Store), learn (Learn, SourceFindings, FindingsGates), deliver (Apply, ApplyGates, PushRules, Retry, KbAutoTrailer, DeliverRules, Host*, CloudInGit), research (GapStep, Queue, QuoteCheck, ResearchConfig, Research, ResearchInKbCopy), report (Digest, DigestHook, Status). test_querylog_e2e.py stays whole. Moving keeps the -k selectors that match class and test names.
